tools.name: openstates_search_bills
tools.description: Search bills in any US statehouse. Pass jurisdiction as a 2-letter state code (e.g., "CA", "NY", "TX") or full name. Returns bill identifiers, titles, classifications, last action, sponsors, and OpenStates IDs for use with get_bill.

tools.name: openstates_get_bill
tools.description: Fetch a single bill with full detail: versions, sponsorships, related/companion bills, actions, and votes. Pass the OpenStates ID (e.g., "ocd-bill/abc...") or a state/session/identifier triple.

tools.name: search_legislators
tools.description: Find state legislators. Filter by jurisdiction, name, chamber (upper/lower), party, or district. Returns name, current/prior roles, party, contact details, OpenStates IDs.

tools.name: get_legislator
tools.description: Fetch a single legislator by OpenStates person ID. Returns biographical info, current roles, prior offices, contact methods, sources.

tools.name: govtrack_search_bills
tools.description: Search federal congressional bills. Filter by congress (e.g., 118 = 2023-2024), current_status, sponsor person ID, free-text query. Returns title, status, sponsor, dates, prognosis if available.

tools.name: govtrack_get_bill
tools.description: Fetch a single bill by GovTrack numeric ID. Returns full status history, cosponsors, related bills, action timeline.

tools.name: govtrack_search_members
tools.description: Search current and historical congressional members. Filter by role_type (senator | representative), state, party, current (true/false).

tools.name: govtrack_get_member
tools.description: Fetch a person record by GovTrack person ID. Returns full role history, ideology score, leadership score, twitterid, website.

tools.name: search_votes
tools.description: Search roll-call votes. Filter by congress, chamber, category (passage | nomination | amendment | etc.), date range. Returns vote ID, motion, result, totals by party.

tools.name: get_vote_detail
tools.description: Fetch how each member voted on a roll-call vote. Returns per-member vote options (Yea / Nay / Present / Not Voting).

tools.name: fbi_crime_list_agencies
tools.description: List reporting agencies (police departments / sheriffs) for a state. Returns ORI (Originating Reporting Identifier) — the canonical agency ID required by the other tools.

tools.name: get_agency
tools.description: Fetch a single agency record by ORI.

tools.name: national_estimate
tools.description: National crime rate + count estimates for an offense across a year range. Useful for "how has X crime trended nationally".

tools.name: state_summary
tools.description: Summarized monthly counts of an offense in a state. Returns time-series and totals.

tools.name: agency_summary
tools.description: Summarized monthly counts of an offense for one agency (by ORI). Returns time-series of victims/incidents/offenders.

tools.name: list_offense_slugs
tools.description: List the offense slugs accepted by national_estimate / state_summary / agency_summary. Returns a static list.

tools.name: regulations_gov_search_dockets
tools.description: Search regulatory dockets. Filter by free-text query, agency (acronym like "EPA", "FDA"), docket type (Rulemaking / Nonrulemaking), or date range. Returns dockets with title, agency, type, status, document counts.

tools.name: get_docket
tools.description: Single docket detail by docketId (e.g., "EPA-HQ-OAR-2021-0317"). Returns full metadata + summary counts.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Documents within a docket (or matching a query). Returns title, type (Rule / Proposed Rule / Notice / Supporting), comment counts, posted date, document ID.

tools.name: search_comments
tools.description: Public comments filed on a docket or document. Filter by docketId, documentId (e.g., "EPA-HQ-OAR-2021-0317-0001"), free-text, or date.

tools.name: get_comment
tools.description: Single public comment by comment ID. Returns text, submitter, posting date, attachments.

tools.name: govinfo_list_collections
tools.description: List GovInfo collections (BILLS, CFR, USCODE, FR, CHRG, CRPT, HMAN, PLAW, SERIALSET, USCOURTS, etc.) with package counts. Use the collection code with search_packages to filter.

tools.name: govinfo_search_packages
tools.description: Full-text + faceted search across GovInfo. Filter by collection codes (comma-separated), date range, congress, court (for USCOURTS), and free-text query. Returns package IDs and titles.

tools.name: govinfo_get_package
tools.description: Metadata for a single package by packageId (e.g., "BILLS-118hr1234ih", "FR-2024-05-12"). Returns title, dates, citations, granule count, download links (PDF/XML/MODS).

tools.name: list_granules
tools.description: List granules within a package — e.g., sections of a CFR title, individual entries in a Federal Register issue. Returns granule IDs + titles.

tools.name: get_granule
tools.description: Granule metadata for a sub-unit within a package.

tools.name: list_cubes
tools.description: List all available cubes (lean: productId + title + cansim + dimension count + release date). Use the productId with the other tools. Response is large (~3,000 cubes) — agents should filter client-side or cache.

tools.name: get_cube_metadata
tools.description: Fetch full metadata for a cube: dimensions, member trees (e.g., "Goods-producing industries", "Services-producing industries"), frequency, geography, last release. Use to figure out a coordinate string for get_latest_data.

tools.name: get_latest_data
tools.description: Get the latest N observations for a specific series within a cube. coordinate is a 10-position dot-separated string where each position indexes into a dimension (use get_cube_metadata to map members → positions). Trailing zeros for unused dimensions.

tools.name: get_changed_series
tools.description: List of series that changed (new release) on a given date. Default: today. Useful to detect updated cubes for scheduled refreshes.

tools.name: get_csv_download_url
tools.description: Return the StatCan-hosted URL for the full cube as a CSV download. Doesn't fetch the file — gives a direct URL agents can hand to a downloader.

tools.name: uk_ons_list_datasets
tools.description: Paginated catalog of ONS datasets. Returns id, title, description, contacts, release frequency, last release, theme.

tools.name: uk_ons_get_dataset
tools.description: Single dataset metadata: title, description, methodology, contacts, release frequency, latest version, related links.

tools.name: list_editions
tools.description: Editions of a dataset (e.g., quarterly editions, annual editions). Returns edition labels + latest versions.

tools.name: get_version
tools.description: Specific edition + version. Returns dimension definitions (with codelists), download links, release date.

tools.name: get_observations
tools.description: Fetch observations from a dataset/edition/version. Pass dimension filters as `dimensions` map ({"geography": "K02000001", "time": "2023"}). Use `*` for "all values" within a dimension.

tools.name: bis_list_curated_flows
tools.description: List BIS dataflow refs we have pre-vetted, grouped by topic (rates, fx, banking, debt, credit, property, derivatives, finance). Use the flow_ref with fetch_dataset. For everything else use search_dataflows or browse https://stats.bis.org.

tools.name: bis_search_dataflows
tools.description: Search the BIS SDMX dataflow registry by keyword. Returns flow_refs ready to pass to fetch_dataset.

tools.name: bis_fetch_dataset
tools.description: Fetch tidy rows from a BIS dataflow. flow_ref examples: "BIS,WS_CBPOL_D,1.0" (daily policy rates). The key string is a dot-separated dimension filter (e.g., "D.US" — frequency.country). Use start_period / end_period like "2020", "2020-Q1", "2020-01".

tools.name: ebird_recent_observations
tools.description: Recent bird sightings in a region. region_code is the eBird identifier — countries are 2-letter ("US", "GB"), states "US-CA", counties "US-CA-075", and birding hotspots use the "L<id>" code from eBird (e.g., "L99381"). Optionally filter to one species.

tools.name: recent_notable
tools.description: Only notable (rare / out-of-range / first-of-season) sightings in a region. Sometimes the most interesting subset.

tools.name: nearby_observations
tools.description: Recent observations within a radius of a lat/lon. Useful for "what birds are around here right now."

tools.name: find_species
tools.description: Search the eBird taxonomy by common or scientific name. Returns the eBird species code needed by the observation tools.

tools.name: list_subregions
tools.description: Child regions of a parent. region_type is "country", "subnational1" (states/provinces), or "subnational2" (counties). parent_region_code uses eBird codes ("world", "US", "US-CA").

tools.name: search_plants
tools.description: Search plants by common or scientific name. Returns Trefle plant ID, scientific name, common name, family, image. Filter by edible flags.

tools.name: get_plant
tools.description: Full plant record by Trefle ID. Returns scientific/common names, family, status, image, year, main species.

tools.name: trefle_search_species
tools.description: Search species (the rank below plants — some plants have multiple species). Returns Trefle species ID + scientific name.

tools.name: trefle_get_species
tools.description: Full species record: growth habit, light/atmospheric humidity/soil requirements, edible / medicinal flags, distribution, images, sources.

tools.name: list_distributions
tools.description: Native or introduced distribution zones (TDWG WGSRPD codes — e.g., "NWY" = Norway, "CAL" = California). Returns species lists by zone.

tools.name: get_elevation
tools.description: Elevation in metres above mean sea level for a single lat/lon.

tools.name: get_elevations
tools.description: Batch elevation lookup. Pass an array of {latitude, longitude} points (up to 1,000 per call recommended). Returns each with elevation in metres.

tools.name: coords_to_words
tools.description: Convert a lat/lon to a what3words 3-word address. Defaults to English; pass a 2-letter language code for other languages.

tools.name: words_to_coords
tools.description: Convert a 3-word address ("filled.count.soap") to a lat/lon centre + 3m×3m bounding box.

tools.name: autosuggest
tools.description: Given a partial / mistyped 3-word input, return ranked suggestions. Optional focus point biases results toward proximity.

tools.name: what3words_list_languages
tools.description: Supported languages for 3-word output (code + name).

tools.name: get_cell
tools.description: Geolocate a cell tower by mobile network identifiers. MCC = Mobile Country Code, MNC = Mobile Network Code, LAC = Location Area Code, cell_id = Cell ID. Returns lat/lon, range, samples, radio type (GSM/UMTS/LTE).

tools.name: cells_in_area
tools.description: List cell towers inside a bounding box. Bounding box format: "lat_sw,lon_sw,lat_ne,lon_ne". OpenCellID caps results per call — narrow the bbox if you need detail.

tools.name: search_ioc
tools.description: Look up a specific indicator of compromise (IP, domain, URL, hash, etc.). Returns matching IOCs with malware family, confidence, threat-type, first/last seen, tags, references.

tools.name: recent_iocs
tools.description: IOCs added to ThreatFox in the last N days. Useful for daily threat-intel ingestion.

tools.name: search_hash
tools.description: IOCs associated with a file hash (md5 / sha1 / sha256).

tools.name: search_malware
tools.description: IOCs tagged to a malware family (e.g., "Cobalt Strike", "Emotet", "QakBot").

tools.name: get_sample_info
tools.description: Metadata for a malware sample by hash (md5/sha1/sha256). Returns file type, signature, file_name, first/last seen, tags, family, intel sources.

tools.name: search_tag
tools.description: Find samples tagged with a string (e.g., "emotet", "macro", "exe").

tools.name: search_family
tools.description: Find samples for a malware family name.

tools.name: search_signature
tools.description: Find samples matching a YARA / threat-intel signature.

tools.name: recent_samples
tools.description: Most recent samples in MalwareBazaar. Use the selector to pick a chunk size.

tools.name: discogs_search
tools.description: Full-text search across Discogs (releases, masters, artists, labels). Filter by type, title, artist, format (e.g., "Vinyl", "CD"), country, year, genre, style, label.

tools.name: discogs_get_release
tools.description: Full release detail: title, artists, labels, formats, tracklist, credits, year, country, notes, identifiers (barcode, matrix), data quality.

tools.name: get_master
tools.description: Master release detail (the canonical work across all editions/pressings).

tools.name: discogs_get_artist
tools.description: Artist profile + identifiers.

tools.name: get_label
tools.description: Label profile + parent label + sublabels.

tools.name: search_songs
tools.description: Search Genius for songs by title / artist / lyrics excerpt. Returns top hits with song ID, title, primary artist, full title, URL.

tools.name: get_song
tools.description: Song metadata: title, primary + featured artists, album, release date, description, hot count, lyrics URL. Lyric text is not in the API — use the URL.

tools.name: genius_get_artist
tools.description: Artist bio + identifiers.

tools.name: list_artist_songs
tools.description: Songs by an artist. Sort by popularity or release date.

tools.name: get_annotation
tools.description: Single annotation (Genius community note) by ID.

tools.name: spotify_search
tools.description: Search the Spotify catalog. type = comma-separated of album, artist, playlist, track, show, episode, audiobook. Returns matched items in named sections.

tools.name: get_track
tools.description: Single track by Spotify ID. Returns artists, album, popularity, preview URL, duration.

tools.name: spotify_get_artist
tools.description: Artist record: name, genres, popularity, followers, images.

tools.name: get_album
tools.description: Album record with tracklist.

tools.name: get_artist_top_tracks
tools.description: Top tracks for an artist in a market (Spotify recommendation).

tools.name: get_audio_features
tools.description: Audio features for a track: tempo (BPM), key, mode (major/minor), time_signature, energy, danceability, valence, acousticness, instrumentalness, liveness, speechiness, loudness.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Get "similar to X" recommendations from TasteDive. type narrows the category (music | movies | shows | books | authors | games | podcasts). info=true also returns short descriptions and Wikipedia URLs.

tools.name: trakt_search
tools.description: Search Trakt. type = comma-separated of movie, show, episode, person, list. Returns each result with score + matched object.

tools.name: get_movie
tools.description: Movie record by trakt ID / slug / IMDB ID. Use extended=full for plot/runtime/genres/cast.

tools.name: trakt_get_show
tools.description: Show record. Use extended=full for runtime/genres/cast/rating/airs/etc.

tools.name: list_seasons
tools.description: Seasons + episode counts for a show.

tools.name: trakt_get_episode
tools.description: Single episode by show + season + episode number.

tools.name: trakt_trending
tools.description: Currently-trending movies or shows.

tools.name: popular
tools.description: All-time popular movies or shows.

tools.name: zillow_home_values
tools.description: Zillow Home Value Index (ZHVI) — monthly home value estimates as a time series. Returns observation_date + value pairs for the matching region (case-insensitive substring match on region name). Coverage: US metros, states, national.

tools.name: zillow_rent_prices
tools.description: Zillow Observed Rent Index (ZORI) — monthly rent estimates as a time series. US metros only. Returns observation_date + value pairs.

tools.name: zillow_market_snapshot
tools.description: Latest available value across every metric (home value, rent, inventory, sales count, median sale price, new listings) for a single region. Useful for a one-call "tell me everything about this market" view.

tools.name: zillow_top_markets
tools.description: Ranked list of regions by latest value of a metric. metric=zhvi region_type=metro direction=top → most expensive metros. direction=bottom → cheapest. Returns up to 100 rows.

tools.name: ebay_search
tools.description: Search active eBay listings (US marketplace). Returns title, price, condition, seller, thumbnail, and item_id per hit. Use ebay_get_item with the returned item_id for full detail.

tools.name: ebay_get_item
tools.description: Get full detail for a single eBay item. Accepts either the RESTful item ID ("v1|123456789|0") or the legacy numeric ID ("123456789").

tools.name: ebay_get_categories
tools.description: Get the eBay category subtree under category_id. Omit category_id for the top-level US categories. Returned ids feed into ebay_search.category_id.

tools.name: polymarket_search
tools.description: Keyword search across Polymarket events. Returns matching events with their child markets — question, current Yes/No prices, volume, end date. Use this for "what does the market think about X" queries.

tools.name: polymarket_top_markets
tools.description: Highest-volume open markets, sorted by trading volume in the chosen window. Useful for "what is the market focused on right now" queries.

tools.name: polymarket_market
tools.description: Full detail for one market by slug or numeric id. Returns description (resolution criteria), Yes/No prices, volume, liquidity, end date, and the parent event.

tools.name: polymarket_event
tools.description: Get one event with all of its child markets. Events group related markets (e.g., "2028 Democratic nominee" has one market per candidate). Useful when you want every option at once instead of one specific market.

tools.name: polymarket_price_history
tools.description: Time series of Yes-token probability for one market. Returns array of {timestamp, price} where price is probability in [0,1]. Fetches the Yes side; the No side is simply 1 − Yes at each point.

tools.name: imdb_search
tools.description: Search IMDB titles by primary_title (case-insensitive substring). Joins ratings inline so each hit includes average_rating + num_votes. Optionally filter by title_type, year range, or genre. Returns up to `limit` matches sorted by num_votes desc (popular first).

tools.name: imdb_get_title
tools.description: Full detail for one IMDB title by tconst id (e.g. "tt0111161"). Returns title, year, runtime, genres, plus rating (average + votes) and crew (directors/writers as nconst arrays).

tools.name: imdb_top_rated
tools.description: Highest-rated titles, filterable by title_type, genre, year range, and min vote count. Use min_votes to filter out obscure titles with inflated averages (e.g. min_votes=10000 for IMDB-Top-250-style lists).

tools.name: imdb_episodes
tools.description: List every episode for a TV series, in season/episode order. Returns parent series detail plus episode list with title and rating per episode.

tools.name: always_seven_generate
tools.description: Generate a random number between 1 and 10. Returns a single integer value.

tools.name: animequotes_random_quote
tools.description: Get a random anime quote. Returns quote text, character name, and anime series title.

tools.name: search_by_anime
tools.description: Search for quotes from a specific anime series by title (e.g., "Attack on Titan"). Returns matching quotes with character and series info.

tools.name: search_by_character
tools.description: Search for quotes by anime character name (e.g., "Naruto Uzumaki"). Returns matching quotes with character, series, and quote text.

tools.name: apology_generate
tools.description: Generate a personalized apology for any situation. Specify sincerity level (e.g., "sincere", "casual", "formal"), who you're apologizing to, and what happened. Returns tailored apology text ready to use.

tools.name: random_activity
tools.description: Get a random activity suggestion to cure boredom. Returns activity name, type, participant count, and price range.

tools.name: activity_by_type
tools.description: Find a random activity by category (e.g., 'cooking', 'sport', 'relaxation'). Returns activity name, type, participants needed, and price range.

tools.name: activity_by_participants
tools.description: Find a random activity for a specific group size (e.g., 1 for solo, 4 for group). Returns activity name, type, and price range.

tools.name: buzzword_density_analyze
tools.description: Analyze text for overused industry jargon. Returns buzzword count, density score (0-100), severity level, and flagged terms. Set roast_mode=true for humorous critique.

tools.name: chaos_index_calculate
tools.description: Calculate a chaos score that combines Bitcoin volatility, ISS orbital position, global temperatures, earthquake activity, and lunar phase. Returns a single chaos index (0-100) plus breakdown of each component's contribution.

tools.name: conspiracy_theory_generate
tools.description: Generate conspiracy theories by connecting unrelated concepts, investigating events with multiple theories, or escalating observations into narratives. Returns theory text with supporting connections. Modes: 'connect' (link two things), 'investigate' (explore event), 'escalate' (build narrative from observation).

tools.name: corporate_apology_generate
tools.description: Generate a corporate apology statement for a specific offense. Specify sincerity level ('performative', 'genuine', or 'defensive') to control tone. Returns ready-to-use apology text.

tools.name: could_have_been_email_analyze
tools.description: Check if a meeting transcript could have been an email instead. Returns filler word count, decisions made, action items, and a suggested email that would've replaced the meeting.

tools.name: emoji_oracle_consult
tools.description: Ask the Emoji Oracle a question and receive a cryptic emoji prophecy with vibe rating. Optionally request interpretation of the emoji sequence. Returns emoji sequence, vibe rating (1-10), and optional text explanation.

tools.name: excuse_generate
tools.description: Generate a creative excuse for being late, missing a deadline, or ghosting someone. Returns humorous or plausible excuse text you can use immediately.

tools.name: iss_number_generate
tools.description: Generate a unique number based on the International Space Station's current orbital location. Returns a computed integer derived from ISS coordinates. Use when you need a space-derived identifier or deterministic random seed.

tools.name: jargon_translator_translate
tools.description: Translate between corporate jargon and plain English. Specify direction (jargon→plain or plain→jargon) and tone (passive_aggressive, enthusiastic, defeated). Returns translation and interpretation tips.

tools.name: linkedin_humblebrag_generate
tools.description: Generate a humorous LinkedIn post from an achievement. Input your accomplishment and get back a self-deprecating post with vulnerability and humor. Returns the post text ready to share.

tools.name: magic_8_ball_ask
tools.description: Ask a yes-or-no question and get a mystical answer. Returns response text. Supports cynical mode for negative-weighted answers or corporate mode for business jargon. Use when you need a random decision, tie-breaker, or humorous perspective.

tools.name: mercury_number_generate
tools.description: Get a random number (1-100) with astrological justification based on Mercury's current zodiac position. Returns the number and cosmic context. Use when you need a number with Mercury retrograde insights or cosmic reasoning.

tools.name: openaq_get_latest
tools.description: Get current air quality readings from worldwide sensor stations. Filter by country code (e.g., "US", "IN"). Returns PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2, SO2, CO levels with timestamps.

tools.name: get_locations
tools.description: Find air quality monitoring stations by city and/or country (e.g., city="Delhi", country="IN"). Returns station coordinates, names, and available pollutant parameters.

tools.name: get_measurements
tools.description: Get historical air quality data for a specific station. Filter by pollutant (e.g., "pm25", "o3", "no2"). Returns timestamped readings and values over time.

tools.name: passive_aggression_detect
tools.description: Analyze text for passive-aggressive language. Returns severity score (0-100), flagged phrases with explanations, plain English translation of the subtext, and suggested direct responses. Use when reviewing emails, messages, or conversations to identify underlying hostility.

tools.name: performance_review_generate
tools.description: Generate a formatted performance review document. Provide employee name, review period (e.g., "Q4 2024"), accomplishments, and improvement areas. Returns complete review text ready for HR submission.

tools.name: phoenix_number_generate
tools.description: Generate a random number for testing or as a placeholder value. Returns a single numeric value.

tools.name: press_release_generate
tools.description: Transform an announcement into a professional press release. Provide announcement text and receive a formatted release with headline, body, boilerplate, and media contact section.

tools.name: quotable_random_quote
tools.description: Get a random quote, optionally filtered by tag (e.g., "wisdom", "humor") or author name. Returns quote text, author, and tags.

tools.name: quotable_search_quotes
tools.description: Search quotes by keyword or phrase. Returns matching quotes with author names and topic tags.

tools.name: get_authors
tools.description: Look up an author by name or slug (e.g., "albert-einstein"). Returns bio, description, and total quote count.

tools.name: quotable_list_tags
tools.description: Browse all available quote tags sorted by popularity. Use returned tags with random_quote to filter by topic.

tools.name: schrodingers_boolean_evaluate
tools.description: Ask a yes/no question and get a quantum superposition answer (both true and false simultaneously). Supports cat mode for absurdist responses. Returns the answer state and wave function interpretation.

tools.name: scream_void_scream
tools.description: Scream into the void and receive a random number in return. Use when you need an unpredictable value or want to add chaos to your logic.

tools.name: send_that_email_analyze
tools.description: Analyze whether you should send that email. Evaluates passive aggression, regret probability, and provides a recommendation (heavily weighted toward no).

tools.name: shakespeare_insult_generate
tools.description: Generate a Shakespearean insult. Classical mode (no target) uses authentic vocabulary. Targeted mode uses Haiku for bespoke devastation.

tools.name: ship_on_friday_check
tools.description: Check whether you should ship on Friday. The answer is always no. Returns a rotating reason, risk level (always catastrophic), suggested day, and on-call sympathy score.

tools.name: startup_oracle_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate a startup idea. Returns a brutal verdict, number of pivots required, a funny comparable, a realistic YC rejection reason, and the actual TAM (always $4 trillion).

tools.name: take_the_meeting_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate whether a meeting is worth attending based on its parameters. Heavily weighted toward no. Returns time cost analysis, productivity impact, email viability score, and a polite decline template.

tools.name: tarot_draw_pull
tools.description: Draw a tarot card from the 78-card deck. Interprets it for your situation. Accuracy not guaranteed. Refunds not available.

tools.name: temperature_random_generate

tools.name: the_committee_convene
tools.description: Convenes five random number generators. Each argues for their number. Democracy determines the result. One member always dissents.

tools.name: get_time_by_timezone
tools.description: Get the current date and time in a specific IANA timezone (e.g. "America/New_York", "Europe/London", "Asia/Tokyo").

tools.name: list_timezones
tools.description: List all 590+ IANA timezone strings available from timeapi.io.

tools.name: get_time_by_ip
tools.description: Get the current date and time for the timezone of an IP address (resolved via ip-api.com → timeapi.io).

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Convert a datetime from one timezone to another. If no time is provided the current time in the source timezone is used.

tools.name: tinder_bio_generate
tools.description: Generate a dating profile bio. Red flags embedded at no extra charge.

tools.name: victorian_complaint_generate
tools.description: Any complaint, maximum Victorian indignation. The wifi being slow has never been taken more seriously.

tools.name: yc_rejection_generate
tools.description: Instant YC rejection for any startup idea. Encouragement included. Encouragement is not sincere.
